85c9e763274a.en: The wall is about 2.3 m wide. The painting hangs at eye level (about 145 cm from the floor).

a5a68dae0703.en: The room is an AI-generated image, and the size is a rough guide to how it might look. The painting is a real photo.

fd66496716de.en: About 0.1 times the height of the ceiling (about 240 cm).

4428df7abe60.en: The wall is about 3.2 m wide. The painting hangs at seated eye level (about 140 cm from the floor).

2b27c99c8910.ja: このナイトテーブルの約 0.4 倍の高さ。
2b27c99c8910.en: About 0.4 times the height of the nightstand.

f7aad4705321.en: About half the height of the lamp (about 45 cm).

9144b743a714.en: The wall is about 1.9 m wide. The painting hangs at seated eye level (about 125 cm from the floor).

a8e9011482f1.ja: 何かをモチーフにしたのではない。
a8e9011482f1.en: It is not based on any motif.

24ec3ef4a2fa.ja: 本能的に、生み出された一枚。

cc61be87f698.ja: ただただ、いろいろな感情が揺らめいている。
cc61be87f698.en: All sorts of feelings, simply flickering.

85a05fefc656.ja: 私自身も、好きな色合い。
85a05fefc656.en: These are colors I love, too.

4c99a29c6efd.ja: 何かを描こうとしたわけじゃない。
4c99a29c6efd.en: I wasn't trying to paint anything in particular.

499f602f094d.ja: いろんな感情が揺らめくまま、本能で生まれた絵。
499f602f094d.en: It was born by instinct, with feelings flickering as they were.

3eb21a02eeb5.ja: 言葉にならない気持ちがあってもいい。
3eb21a02eeb5.en: It's all right to have feelings you can't put into words.

bb4d4d28bb7e.ja: そのまま、ここにいていい。
bb4d4d28bb7e.en: You can stay here, just as you are.
